messages:
emily: Heads-up: opened a docs PR that updates the SDK examples in the migration guide. Preview CI failed with markdownlint + spellcheck + linkcheck. blocking merge.

dryan: Can you paste the CI errors?

emily: TLDR: markdownlint flagged `MD033` (inline HTML), spellcheck flagged `authn` as a typo, linkcheck found a broken external link to `https://thirdparty.example.com/sdk-setup` (404). Full logs: `docs/preview:markdownlint (1 error)`, `docs/preview:spell (2 warnings)`, `docs/preview:linkcheck (1 broken)`.

priya: `authn` is our shorthand but docs spellcheck is strict. We should either add it to the spell whitelist or rewrite to "authentication" in the guide. Which do we prefer?

emily: For the migration guide I'd prefer full word `authentication`. Less friction for external readers. I'll change it.

sam: About the external 404: that vendor changed their path last week. We can't rely on them. Options: update link to vendor's new URL, vendor permalink, or snapshot the example in our repo and link internally. I vote for internal snapshot + note.

docs-ci-bot: docs/preview run 1923456901 — markdownlint: MD033 inline HTML found in `guides/migration.md` line 112; spellcheck: unknown word `authn` (2 instances); linkcheck: 1 external 404. See https://ci.redwood/run/1923456901/results

priya: I'll quick PR a patch: replace `authn` -> `authentication`, remove the inline HTML tag (we used <kbd>...</kbd> for keys; convert to backticks), and point the vendor link to `https://thirdparty.example.com/sdk-setup-v2` which I confirmed returns 200.

emily: Nice. If you update the vendor link please also add a short `(archival copy)` note in case it moves again.

priya: Pushed changes and triggered a docs/preview re-run. Also added `docs/spell-whitelist.txt` entry for `Redwood-API` for future PRs.

docs-ci-bot: docs/preview run 1923457005 — checks: markdownlint ✅, spellcheck ✅ (no new warnings), linkcheck ✅. Preview: https://preview.redwood/docs/1923457005

emily: Thanks! Can we get a +1 and a reviewer approval? This needs to land before we cut the `release/rc-2.1` branch at 17:30 PT.

sam: @priya can you self-request review? otherwise @ryan can you glance and approve?

ryan: Quick skim: examples look good, removed the HTML, links ok. I'm approving now. :+1:

emily: Merged to main and queued backport to `release/rc-2.1`. Adding a follow-up issue to evaluate replacing fragile external links with vendor-permalinks or internal snapshots. ISSUE-427 filed.

priya: Optional: we should add a CI rule to warn (not fail) on external link failures for vendor domains so authors have a chance to snapshot. Filing ISSUE-428.

emily: Agreed — not blocking this merge. Closing thread.
